title: Injury to property, etc.–Any person subject to this Act who commits any of the following
text:
36. Injury to property, etc.–Any person subject to this Act who commits any of the following
offences, namely:–

(a) destroys or injures any property mentioned in clause (a) of section35,or any property
belonging to any Force mess, band or institution, or to any person subject to this Act; or

(b) commits any act which causes damage to, or destruction of, any property of the Government
by fire; or

(c) kills, injures, makes away with, ill-treats or loses, any animal entrusted to him,

shall, on conviction by a Force Court, be liable, if he has acted wilfully, to suffer imprisonment for a term
which may extend to tenyears or such less punishment as is in this Act mentioned; and if he has acted
without reasonable excuse, to suffer imprisonment for a term which may extend to five years or such less
punishment as is in this Act mentioned.
